run_ttad_repl: run the ttad REPL script to interactively parse natural language commands into action dictionaries
parse_natural_language_to_actions: parse a natural language command like build me a cube into an action dictionary using ActionDictBuilder
build_action_dict_from_text: build an action dictionary from a list of natural language strings using ActionDictBuilder.parse
review_actiondictbuilder_class: review the ActionDictBuilder class from ttad_model_wrapper for parsing natural language into action dicts
summarize_ttad_repl_script: summarize the ttad REPL utility script that queries the ttad model with natural language input
